label: GO only: high S1 belief, peaks after rare-unrewarded a1 (a1 S2 u) following a reward
terms: (phase == GO) * belief ** 8 ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * belief ** 4 ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == -1) * (prev_reward == 0) * belief ** 4
explanation: Fires only at GO (zero at D1/D2). Magnitude grows steeply with the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good (belief**8), i.e. a confident a1 commitment inferred from observed history. Largest (~0.9-1.0) at GO after a rare-unrewarded a1 trial (a1 S2 u, the model-based stay-on-a1 case) scaled by belief**4, but that boost vanishes when the trial before was also unrewarded (two losses in a row). After common-rewarded a1 (a1 S1 r) it is moderate (~0.3-0.55) and decreases over consecutive rewards (negative a1 S1 r x previous reward term). Lowered after any a2 choice, after a1 S2 r (rare rewarded, switch case) and after a1 S1 u. A window-first-trial term (previous trial unseen, reward input 0, high belief) catches unseen a1 S2 u cases. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.44 (dev 0.45), vs all-observed reference 0.38 and all ceiling 0.46; the earlier model-based description (policy logit a1 > 9) had a policy-decile reference of 0.36 alone, so observed-only terms lose essentially nothing here. Just under the 0.45 explained threshold.
